description: Claims (claimed true) or releases (claimed false) one Showcase company for this business, as the Showcase link card does, so the Photos page shows the right company's photos. companyId is the Showcase company's id. Reversible. Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; the same claim is one change. An owner-level change: Sergio tells the owner after it is made.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

reason.description: Why you are doing this, in one sentence. The owner sees it in the notice Sergio sends after the change.

name: claim_showcase_company
title: Claim or release a Showcase company
